name: openbb_equity_discovery_gainers
description:
Top gaining US stocks today through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.discovery.gainers).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (accepted by the schema, ignored by this command); provider (fmp or yfinance; schema default fmp; when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which needs no key).
Custom filters: openbb_equity_screener; other source: fmp_market_gainers. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "yfinance"}
